answer: Beacon spot-checks plus a compute pulse stop hollow identities. Each epoch the beacon draws 5% of agents; each drawn one must answer in 10 minutes with a heartbeat proving work. A hollow shell cannot fake the pulse; two missed checks freeze it and burn its 200 POA deposit. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 40 POA monthly, 40,000 POA. An honest agent pays one 40 POA heartbeat, keeps earnings whole, and earns an opal seal for priority jobs.
